propositions: jira_dc_pat fixture is function-scoped, causing one new PAT to be minted per test, exhausting Jira DC's 10-token-per-user cap as test count grows
The 403 PAT creation error surfaces in unrelated modules because the budget is session-wide and only exhausted when an arbitrary test happens to run last
Tokens self-clear after 1 day, making failures appear flaky but deterministic based on when the instance was last used
Session scope would reduce PAT consumption from O(tests) to O(1), requiring only one token per run since no test asserts per-token behavior
A complementary session-start sweep of leftover rebar-j5-harness-* tokens prevents crashed runs from poisoning the next run with stale PATs
Unit tests must verify the sweep parses responses correctly, handles enumerate failures by returning empty, ignores non-prefixed tokens, and tolerates DELETE failures
